title: IFCS60-QBOOST173: explicit n8 maximum helper sharpens the quarterboost exact time polynomial

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s, n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE physical IFCS60-QBOOST173-POLYLEDGER algorithm supplied completely in proof.md, virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md uses the finite tester for n<4096 and otherwise mu0=5999/10000,H00=38662667/23996000,w_s the least integer with100000000*w_s²>=35988001*n,v_s the least integer withv_s^4>=n,nu=v_s,gamma0,the complete saturated binary/four-input schedule,original source/LE/fallback/delivery guards and both full-modulus decoders,typed SMALL/GLOBALBIG basis banks and the explicit acyclic helper/driver completion. Its unconditional ENTIRE-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch T=O(n^16*2^((38662667/23996000)*sqrt(n))),ordinary S_C=O(n),full allocated S_Q=O(n^2*2^((5999/10000)*sqrt(n))),and total Q=O(n^(7/4)*2^((38662667/23996000)*sqrt(n)-n^(1/4))). All failures,rejections,discards,partial attempts,retries,source/fallback/cap aborts,initialization,full address debits,source moves,lifecycle work,finite exact epoch repair and cleanup count with absolute outside constants and exact displayed coefficients/powers. The corresponding resource claim is total work, with exact growth index 1/2. The same explicit physical helper program selects its fully proved n8 maximum per complete event and unchanged n4 event count,giving n12 simulator and n16 total work; all original capacities,source/guards,full span and exact finite repair remain.
